rows.jyutping: zoi3 zeoi6 faan2 maai4 jat1 cai4
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to say that people or groups unite again after being apart.

example.english: After being apart for years, we finally rejoin.
example.traditional: 大家分開咗幾年，今日終於再聚返埋一齊喇。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 fan1 hoi1 zo2 gei2 nin4 gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 zoi3 zeoi6 faan2 maai4 jat1 cai4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone joins a group, team, or organisation again rather than simply returning to someone's presence.

example.english: I want to rejoin the basketball team next season.
example.traditional: 我想下季再加入籃球隊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 haa6 gwai3 zoi3 gaa1 jap6 laam4 kau4 deoi2

rows.traditional: 返 + 嚟/去 + 同 A 一齊
rows.jyutping: faan2 lai4 heoi3 tung4 A jat1 cai4
rows.note: Use this when someone comes or goes back to be with a particular person again; choose 嚟 toward the speaker and 去 away from the speaker.

example.english: Come back and rejoin me for dinner after work.
example.traditional: 你放工就返嚟同我一齊食飯啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 fong3 gung1 zau6 faan1 lai4 tung4 ngo5 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 laa1
